reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I've answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-random.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging, which freezes when it scans the bill-of-lading barcode. Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2025-07-02. Hollis is a member of that channel, so I only used what he can already see. In the reply I also told him not to confuse it with #8841, which is a different ticket for the West yard Door 2 double-booking.

The gbrain search didn't work. It rejected the request because this connection isn't tied to any member. To fix that, someone on the brain host needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`, or set the connection up as a shared agent with `--may-act-for`.
